[ASSISTANT_SAID] Key differences between Garmin Edge 530 and Edge 130 include:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Edge 530 has a 2.6-inch color touchscreen display (246x322 pixels) vs. Edge 130's 1.8-inch monochrome display (303x230 pixels).  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Edge 530 offers advanced performance features like Cycling Dynamics, MTB Dynamics, ClimbPro, and FTP tracking.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Edge 530 has advanced navigation features, while Edge 130 is more basic.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Edge 530 has a longer battery life (up to 20 hours) compared to Edge 130 (12 hours).  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Edge 130 is more affordable, with a price difference of around $100-$150.
